title: Production Learning & Autonomous Roadmap Renewal
purpose: Close the 351–361 learning cycle and convert current observability into the next bounded autonomous release sequence without creating a parallel business authority.

learning_review.learning: Missing, stale, capped, and permission-hidden evidence is no longer presented as a trustworthy zero.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Preserve confidence while adding outcome trends instead of one-time snapshots.

learning_review.learning: Duplicate exceptions collapse to one source-backed queue item with advisory next action.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Measure whether reviewed exceptions close, recur, or expose a different upstream problem.

learning_review.learning: Seven- and fourteen-day readiness separates spring/summer, fall, winter, and four-season load.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Compare forecast constraints with actual schedule recovery and completed capacity.

learning_review.learning: Planned duration/travel and recorded execution can be compared without inventing employee scores.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Learn route/stop-sequence friction from repeated plan-versus-actual evidence.

learning_review.learning: Renewal, hold, friction, complaint, and optional profitability evidence are visible together.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Track renewal conversion, churn reason, and retention outcome without automatic customer commitments.

learning_review.learning: Accepted-not-scheduled, completed-not-invoiced, extras, collections, and margin leakage are visible.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Measure estimate accuracy and cycle-time recovery outcomes across the commercial chain.

learning_review.learning: Crew-level labour and asset use are visible without individual performance ranking.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Improve capture completeness and connect downtime/replacement evidence to operating cost.

learning_review.learning: Scheduled demand, recurring coverage, unit mismatch, and seasonal stock context are explicit.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Compare planned versus actual use and calibrate reorder evidence without auto-purchasing.

learning_review.learning: Schedule-change, follow-up, recurring notice, CRM, and A/R reminder candidates are deduplicated.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Measure recorded follow-up outcomes while preserving consent/provider boundaries.

learning_review.learning: Duplicate, orphan, cross-module, stale-assignment, and seasonal-tag issues are visible without destructive repair.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Record remediation outcomes and recurrence so source-quality improvement can be measured.

learning_review.learning: Mobile read fan-out, payload size, refresh behavior, replay batch size, and shell/admin cache behavior now have explicit budgets.
learning_review.remaining_gap: Track reliability/read-budget trend and regressions across releases rather than only enforcing a point-in-time ceiling.

renewal_principles: Prefer measurable operator, reliability, seasonal, economic, or data-quality outcomes over release-number churn.
Use existing canonical Jobs, Safety, Equipment, Employment, CRM, Finance, Dispatch, recurring-service, workability, inventory, and release-evidence authorities before creating new storage.
Where an outcome journal is required, record only the decision/outcome metadata needed for learning; never duplicate the source business record.
Keep spring/summer landscaping and lawn work, fall cleanup/leaf work, winter snow/storm/ice operations, and general four-season functions explicit.
Do not require external provider credentials, real payments, real customer messages, staging acceptance, or manual signoff to complete ordinary autonomous roadmap items.
Keep Finance posting, payment-provider mutation, external Auth controls, provider delivery, and destructive data reconciliation fail-closed unless separately authorized and evidenced.
Every future release must preserve exact-source release evidence, permission enforcement, mobile accessibility, and offline conflict ownership.
